narrative:

In fact, the vast majority of successful students drink very little or not at all on weekdays. Heavy weekday drinking can disrupt sleep, concentration, and study time, and this pattern alone outweighs the positive signals in your profile.

The second most important factor actually works in your favor: you have never failed a class before. That shows you are capable of handling your coursework and that a strong academic foundation is there. Your desire to continue into higher education is also protective, since every student who passed in this dataset shared that same ambition. These two factors push strongly toward passing, but they cannot fully cancel out the risk created by your weekday drinking.

To improve, focus on reducing alcohol during school days and protecting your evening study time. Remember that you already have the motivation and the track record to succeed. A meaningful change in your daily routine, especially around drinking, could be enough to turn this warning around.
